messages:
maya_cs: Quick summary from today's Greenline onboarding review (20m): three product asks and one critical data/ops gap that could affect their renewal timeline. Posting raw notes here for triage.

alejandro_cs: Items: (1) embedding search returns stale docs ~12-24h after reindex. (2) finance wants per-route cost roll-up in Console. (3) they need route-level access controls for internal teams. Blocking: org admin bulk-invite flow errors on >250 users.

opsbot: New ticket created: CS-4902 — bulk-invite failure (>250) — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4902 

tess_prod: Can you paste their exact repro steps for the embedding staleness? Also did they run a full reindex or incremental patch? Any TTLs set on vectors/indexes?

maya_cs: Repro steps from Greenline: 1) upload dataset via Console CSV, 2) trigger reindex (console UI), 3) immediately run search against route. Example they used: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/search -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"route":"greenline-kb","query":"Where to find billing breakdowns"}'``` They said results still showed pre-upload content for ~14 hours. They toggled client cache:false and retried. Reindex timestamp: 2026-03-10T14:07:02Z.

joey_pm: If runtime isn't invalidating per-route KV caches on reindex, queries will surface stale embeddings. @tess_prod any idea how often the control-plane emits reindex events, and whether the runtime subscribes to them?

tess_prod: Hypothesis: control-plane emits event but runtime filters by dataset id and our fanout missed the route namespace. Quick triage: (a) ask CS for reindex event logs (control-plane) and runtime logs around 14:07Z, (b) check event bus health. If missing fanout, fix is straightforward but needs careful rollout. Rough estimate: 2 engineers, 3 business days including integration tests.

alejandro_cs: Customer impact: they paused two paid feature launches pending consistent search. Marking as renewal risk. They asked for weekly updates.

maya_cs: I've asked Greenline to share logs and to authorize a manual invalidate if we recommend it. Also added a short feature request doc link for per-route cost: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/greenline-per-route-costs — includes sample billing rows they'd like to see. Priorities suggested: Embedding staleness = P0, Per-route cost = P1, Route RBAC = P2, Bulk-invite fix = P2.

joey_pm: I'll move embedding-staleness into next sprint triage and prep contingency plan (manual invalidate runbook). @tess_prod please confirm if we have an internal cache-flush endpoint we can safely run per-customer.

tess_prod: We do have an internal invalidate endpoint for emergency ops. Prefer to confirm logs before running. If confirmed, we can run a targeted invalidate and follow with the automated fanout patch.

alejandro_cs: Thanks — I'll coordinate weekly status notes to Greenline and loop AM/solutions for renewal messaging.

maya_cs: Added action items: (1) CS to collect logs and permissions (2) Prod to triage and estimate patch ETA (3) PM to schedule triage slot (4) Ops to prepare runbook draft.
